summary: Partial IdP certificate chain causes SAML assertion signature validation failures (private deployment)
description: Issue summary: Customer FinScale reports intermittent 403 Authorization failures for users authenticating via their on-prem SAML IdP against a Redwood Private deployment. Errors begin after a recent IdP cert rotation performed by the customer. Impact: A subset of FinScale users cannot authenticate; affected users see immediate 403 on redirect back to the app. Root cause appears to be SAML signature validation failing due to an incomplete certificate chain delivered by the IdP. This manifests as 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority' in our SP logs.
impact: ~12% of FinScale logins failing across eu-west for SAML SSO. No token issuance; downstream services see 403s and elevated helpdesk tickets. Customer flagged as regulated finance customer; high priority for remediation.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure a SAML SP integration in a private deployment with FinScale IdP metadata (the customer's rotated cert is in metadata)
2) Trigger SSO flow from app -> IdP -> redirect back to SP in eu-west prod
3) Observe SAML response validation failure and immediate 403 returned to user
4) Capture SAML response (base64 XML) and inspect embedded X.509Certificate element; intermediate CA is not present in the assertion/signing block
5) Run 'openssl verify' against the embedded cert using our configured truststore; verify fails with 'unable to get local issuer certificate'
logs: 2026-03-10T08:41:12Z auth.saml: signature validation error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (sp.go:342)
2026-03-10T08:41:13Z nginx: upstream returned 403 while reading response header from upstream
investigation_notes: Customer performed a cert rotation; their IdP metadata now publishes only the leaf cert (observed in received metadata xml).
Our SAML validation library (internal fork of gosaml2) requires a valid chain to an issuer in our truststore; it does not currently attempt AIA fetching for intermediates.
SRE reproduced locally by crafting SAML response with leaf-only cert: openssl verify fails unless intermediate is provided.
Temporary mitigation tested: updating SP truststore to include customer's intermediate CA allowed validation and restored logins for the test user.
Search in prod logs shows ~120 distinct request_ids with same failure pattern starting 2026-03-09 22:00 UTC (matching customer's rotation time).
Related Slack thread: #support-private-sso (slack.com/archives/C02SUPP123/p1678543212000) contains customer's rotation announcement and initial troubleshooting notes.
Related GitHub PR to add optional AIA fetching and improved diagnostic logs created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity/pull/4789 (under review).
comments: Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-10: Initial triage with customer indicates cert rotation on their IdP. Collected SAMLResponse and metadata. Attached sample and opened ticket.

FinScale SRE (customer) 2026-03-10: Confirmed rotation; our IdP publishes leaf only due to internal policy. We can publish intermediate if required but prefer not to until we understand impact. Requesting guidance.

Liam O'Connor (SRE) 2026-03-11: Verified validation failure locally. Short-term workaround: add customer's intermediate to the SP truststore in the private control plane or ask IdP to include full chain. Preparing a patch to add AIA fetching as fallback.

Platform Security (2026-03-11): Adding intermediate to truststore is acceptable for now but must be recorded in change log and approved by customer security. Recommend documenting permanent fix before wider rollout.
Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-12: Customer approved temporary truststore update. Applying to eu-west private instance during off-peak window and monitoring.
Liam O'Connor (SRE) 2026-03-12: Deployed temporary truststore change; observed successful logins for previously failing users. Monitoring for 24h.
Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-12: Customer requests an action item to avoid manual intervention on future rotations. Escalating to identity engineering for a robust fix.
resolution: Workaround: temporarily added FinScale intermediate CA to the private control plane truststore for eu-west, which restored logins. Long-term plan: merge AIA-fetch fallback in identity library (PR #4789) and add a diagnostic in Console to surface missing chain errors in SSO logs. Also update SAML onboarding docs to require full chain or AIA-enabled endpoints from IdPs. Follow-up task: INT-4021 to add automated AIA retrieval and better logging. Change log entry created in Confluence runbook.
next_steps: 1) Complete code review and roll PR #4789 to staging (owner: @sso-team, ETA 2026-03-18)
2) Add a Console diagnostic banner for private customers indicating 'SAML cert chain incomplete' with suggested remediation (owner: @console-team)
3) Coordinate with FinScale to confirm process for future rotations and update their metadata to include full chain if policy allows
4) Close ticket after 48h of healthy login metrics post-workaround and after PR is deployed to staging for validation
